Learn to set up a fully autonomous AI development system that handles the entire software lifecycle from your phone. In 10 practical steps you will install an AI coding agent, give it persistent memory and version-controlled knowledge, run multiple agents in parallel with Git worktrees, connect a task manager, automate deployment, add AI code review, and finally orchestrate everything from a single conversation on your phone.

No more sitting behind a code editor. You remain responsible for decisions and approvals — your agents handle the implementation. This is how modern autonomous software development works.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to know how to code to take this course?

Basic terminal knowledge is helpful, but the agents do the actual coding. If you understand what software does and can describe what you want, the agents handle the rest.

Which AI agent does this course use?

The course demonstrates Claude Code (Anthropic) as the primary coding agent. The principles apply equally to Cursor, Windsurf, or any agent that runs locally with tool access.

What kind of computer do I need?

Any machine that can run Node.js or Python and has internet access. A VPS or home server works perfectly — you do not need to run it on your phone; the phone is just your command interface.

How long does it take to set up the full system?

The core setup (Steps 1 to 5) takes about 30 to 60 minutes. The full system including deployment automation and mobile access takes a half day the first time.
